title: Lost something? Let’s get it back.
eyebrow: A place for lost things. And the people who find them.
intro: Report a lost or found item, explore possible matches and arrange a return in Renuir.
availability: App Store and Google Play links will be added after approval.
flowTitle: One report. A clearer next step.
flowIntro: From a first photo to a confirmed handover.
postBody: Add photos, a description, and where and when. With your permission, AI can suggest details for your report.
matchBody: Compare lost and found reports using photos, location and timing. AI suggestions help you look; they do not prove ownership.
chatBody: Message the other person in the app and check identifying details before arranging a return. You do not need to share your phone number to chat.
handoverBody: Agree on a public meeting place and confirm an in-person return with a one-time handover code.
petsBody: Report a missing pet or share a sighting with a location and photo. Review sightings to help decide where to look next.
closingTitle: Made for the moments that matter.
closingBody: Browse reports as a guest. Create an account to take part. Publishing may require verification. Optional Boosts are paid.
safetyBody: Keep identifying details out of public posts. Check ownership, meet in a public place, and report inappropriate content in the app.
